annotations.text:
Graph panels for the Audit Desk item view.

A (top) is the candidate: reading order runs left to right, every arrow points at the result a proof USES, the current item is the gold node with a flag, and the neighbourhood panel reads upstream → this item → downstream.

B and C are alternates on two axes: B makes chapter structure explicit; C shows only the current item's citations.

Sample data: Karatzas–Shreve Theorem 1.3.13 (real edges from the desk).
